title: Undeclared snapshot files
responsibility: Finds files created outside tracked source, declared outputs and shared links in a verification snapshot.

inputs.name: declaredOutput.path
inputs.description: Snapshot-relative file or directory path to test against output patterns.

inputs.name: snapshotAdditions.directory
inputs.description: Snapshot root directory to walk recursively.

inputs.name: snapshotAdditions.bounds
inputs.description: Tracked paths, declared output patterns and shared-link paths that are allowed.

inputs.name: snapshotAdditions.prefix
inputs.description: Optional relative subtree prefix ending in slash when nonempty; defaults to empty.

outputs.name: declaredOutput
outputs.description: True when a pattern matches the path or its directory form with a trailing slash.

outputs.name: snapshotAdditions
outputs.description: Sorted paths of untracked non-directory entries outside allowed outputs/links. Allowed directories are not entered; filesystem errors reject.
